title: Introducing ELLIPS: An Ethics-Centered Approach to Research on LLM-Based Inference of Psychiatric Conditions
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to establishing an ethical framework (the ELLIPS toolkit) for research involving the inference of psychiatric conditions using LLMs. It defines and operationalizes seven core ethical principles: Autonomy, Beneficence, Justice, Responsible Scientific Inference, Credit Allocation, Transparency, and Social Responsibility.
